headline: Ransomware Strikes Denso, Yet Production Remains Steady
body: Denso Corporation, a significant player in the automotive component market, recently encountered a ransomware attack targeting its IT system. The breach focused on their office network and scheduling systems. Despite this, Denso's core machining operations continued without interruption thanks to swift manual interventions by their team. While certain deliveries could experience minor delays as a result of the incident, the company has assured clients that the impact will be minimal. Proactive communication has been initiated with their customer plants to ensure transparency during this period.
